value.rationale: Exact minimal global polynomial degree is a natural algebraic complexity invariant left undetermined by the established fact of polytope algebraic integrability. The theorem completely classifies it for all parallelotopes and reveals its rapid growth governed by the Boolean threshold count (1880 already at dimension four), with an all-dimensional structural lower bound and explicit extremizing relation rather than an arbitrary finite table.
